newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen Group climbs in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Loewen Group climbs in heavy trading.

text.p: Shares in Loewen Group Inc bounced higher on Thursday amid market sentiment that Service Corp International's hostile bid for the Canadian-based funeral home operator may succeed, but at a higher price.
Loewen was up 3.25 at 57.75 in early afternoon turnover of 1.05 million shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange. On Nasdaq, Loewen rose 2-1/4 to 42 on 719,000 shares.
Traders said there were no obvious white knights to assist Loewen. "People believe at this stage that it will be hard find somebody else who has the muscle," a trader said.

Houston-based Service Corp, North America's biggest funeral home operator, is proposing a stock swap deal valued at US$43 a share. The total value of the deal is about US$4.1 billion, including the assumption of debt.

"People feel there is a good chance that Service Corp can work this takeover and make it happen. They may have to pay a dollar or two higher, but it's hard to imagine a white knight coming in," the trader said.
Service Corp has said it would be willing to increase its offer after a due diligence review.
